Results.ReviewText: Bought it a year ago along with the collapsible stand. The cast iron grill is not wide open like a typical wire type grill. It is mostly a solid surface, with some slots in it to let the grease drip to the grease catch below. Because of this, it is hard to clean it by getting it very hot and brushing it to clean it. You almost need to remove the grill and wash it, which is kind of a messy job.  The cast iron grill also makes it very heavy. On the plus side, it cooks great. The slots in the cast iron grill are not over the burners so when the grease drips down it does not start on fire. You don't need to cook with a garden hose in one hand. Hot dogs can be "browned" and not either black, or cold. Steaks, or anything cook very well. Overall, I am very happy and would recommend it.
Results.Title: Overall very happy

Results.ReviewText: Not disappointed at all with this purchase..highly recommend

Just buy one and you too can start enjoying the best there is. Thanks Webber. P.S. buy the hose and a larger tank the 1 lb bottles are great for Tailgate but not for everyday use just my 2cents worth.

Results.ReviewText: Bought this for use in our RV, so storage size and portability were factors.  Normally only two of us to cook for so this purchase was also by design because of that.  Heats up fast, including at high altitudes where other grills and charcoal fail.  Cools off and cleans up quickly and easily.  I only have one critical concern: the fuel control valve should have a locking device on it to prevent accidentally turning on the gas.  The knob is sensitive to pressure and got bumped into the on position and drained the tank.  I noticed the iced over tank and found the knob had been knocked into the on position.  While being nothing more than an inconvenience at that moment because I had plenty of extra tanks, it does pose a safety concern.  When at a camp site for several days, users will not remove the bottle after each use; therefore, a knob locking device would have prevented this from happening, and a potential explosive incident.  Otherwise, this grill is perfect for what I need it for.

I like the grill a lot. I find the variable gas settings and temperature gauge to be invaluable. It is solid and well made. 
There are times where I would like it if it was bigger which which gets to the subject of improvements and what I only gave a three stars. That said I researched a lot of grills in this market segment and concluded it was my best value.
The grill has a single burner and control. I like to use the griddle however you can only place a griddle on one half. That means I am wasting gas under the grill portion. If I want to use the grill portion and griddle I have to try and find one setting that works for both the griddle and the grill. 
To score 5 I would like to be able to have the flexibility of being able to have a full griddle top and a burner/control for each half.
